Draft plan – first 6 picks

Pick your slot, then click the player you actually took. Children are ranked by expected categories won (of 9); gaps under ~0.1 are ties. If a player is gone, take the next one down.
Each box = projected % of the 9 opponents you beat in that category at the END of the draft, assuming these picks and then the best fill for the other rounds. It is not the stats of the players picked so far. “Strong” = 70%+.
The 10 best full 6-pick combos for each slot, re-scored on fresh simulated drafts. Boxes show the projected % of opponents you beat per category for the full 13-man team (these 6 picks, then the best fill).
